Have a nice day,

Charles

messages.subject: Creating repositories at R Team Salsa group and RFS
messages.subject_clean: Creating repositories at R Team Salsa group and RFS
messages.body_plain:
Hello Debian R team,

I'm doing my 1st steps on R packaging, I've started to create a package
for the CRAN "rscopus" from [1] and I've created a repository for this
package under my Salsa user space at [2].

I would like to know what are the recommendations to move this package
to the Debian R team Salsa group at [3]? Can I just move the Salsa
repository from my user space [1] to the Debian R team at [3]?

Besides that, I would like also to ask what is the preferred way to ask
help for reviewing and Sponsorship (RFS)? Should I use the
mentors.debian.net [4]?

I'm a non-upload DD.

[1] https://cran.r-project.org/package=rscopus
[2] https://salsa.debian.org/joenio/r-cran-rscopus
[3] https://salsa.debian.org/r-pkg-team
[4] https://mentors.debian.net

Thank you,
-- 
Joenio Marques da Costa
Research Software Engineer - Cortext Platform
PhD student - Institute of Computing - UFBA
https://joenio.me/about

messages.body_plain:
Hi Joenio,

Am Thu, Nov 19, 2026 at 06:42:29PM +0100 schrieb Joenio Marques da Costa:
> Hello Debian R team,
> 
> I'm doing my 1st steps on R packaging, I've started to create a package
> for the CRAN "rscopus" from [1] and I've created a repository for this
> package under my Salsa user space at [2].

I have not (yet) looked at this package - but thanks for doin so and
also thank you for showing up on the team list with this question.
 
> I would like to know what are the recommendations to move this package
> to the Debian R team Salsa group at [3]? Can I just move the Salsa
> repository from my user space [1] to the Debian R team at [3]?

I hope so.  I just added you to the team.  The invitation does enable
developer but not maintainer (for whatever reason).  Please let us know
if this is sufficient to move the repository.
 
> Besides that, I would like also to ask what is the preferred way to ask
> help for reviewing and Sponsorship (RFS)? Should I use the
> mentors.debian.net [4]?

I personally ignore mentors.d.n and usually respond to sponsorship
requests on the mailing list.
 
> I'm a non-upload DD.

Nice.  Perhaps you become an uploading DD later so you might be able
to work more independently. ;-)

Welcome in the team
   Andreas.

> [1] https://cran.r-project.org/package=rscopus
> [2] https://salsa.debian.org/joenio/r-cran-rscopus
> [3] https://salsa.debian.org/r-pkg-team
> [4] https://mentors.debian.net
> 
> Thank you,
> -- 
> Joenio Marques da Costa
> Research Software Engineer - Cortext Platform
> PhD student - Institute of Computing - UFBA
> https://joenio.me/about
> 
> 

--

> 
> I hope so.  I just added you to the team.  The invitation does enable
> developer but not maintainer (for whatever reason).  Please let us know
> if this is sufficient to move the repository.

Thanks for adding me to the group, I don't know why the Gitlab Salsa
doesn't list the group in the options to transfer a repository, I've
solved it by re-creating the repository in the group.

>> Besides that, I would like also to ask what is the preferred way to ask
>> help for reviewing and Sponsorship (RFS)? Should I use the
>> mentors.debian.net [4]?
> 
> I personally ignore mentors.d.n and usually respond to sponsorship
> requests on the mailing list.

Ok, I'll then ask help in the list for reviewing and RFS when needed, I
suppose I'll need a lot of help.
>> I'm a non-upload DD.
> 
> Nice.  Perhaps you become an uploading DD later so you might be able
> to work more independently. ;-)

I plan to do that, I hope soon I can find some time to do that :)

I've done some packages, I would love to have some feedback. I did my
best but sure there are opportunities for improvements, below are the
Salsa repositories I've pushed to the group.

https://salsa.debian.org/r-pkg-team/r-cran-contentanalysis
https://salsa.debian.org/r-pkg-team/r-cran-dimensionsr
https://salsa.debian.org/r-pkg-team/r-cran-openalexr
https://salsa.debian.org/r-pkg-team/r-cran-pubmedr
https://salsa.debian.org/r-pkg-team/r-cran-rscopus

Thank you very much, happy to join the group.

All the best,
-- 
Joenio Marques da Costa
Research Software Engineer - Cortext Platform - Gustave Eiffel
University (UGE)
PhD student - Institute of Computing - Federal University of Bahia (UFBA)
